name: Zentralalpen-Stellplatz Trins im Gschnitztal
beschreibung: The Zentralalpen-Stellplatz Trins im Gschnitztal is located in the municipality of Trins in the Gschnitztal of the same name, a side valley of the Wipptal in Tirol. The site is situated at around 1,230 metres above sea level and is surrounded by the mountains of the Stubaier Alpen. The surrounding area offers access to hiking trails of varying difficulty that lead to alpine pastures, mountain lakes and higher peaks. In the winter months, it is possible to reach nearby ski areas in the region. The site has pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as basic amenities such as electricity connections and sanitary areas. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and close to nature, characterized by the alpine valley setting with views of the surrounding mountain ranges. Near the campsite, guests will find shopping facilities and dining options in the centre of Trins. The site is suitable as a starting point for activities in nature during all seasons.
